migrated.content:
20th Level: Doublecast

Your potency as a Caster is the thing of legend, your name one for the history books.

Once per Short Rest, when you cast an Art with a Casting Time of an Action, you may immediately cast a second Art as part of the same Action. This second Art ignores restrictions on casting multiple levelled Arts during a single Turn.

Basic Caster Skills
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Artseeker1010OffensiveBonus ActionRanged Spell Attack Rolls you make this Turn are made with Advantage, and ignore the benefits of Half and Three-Quarters Cover.1 Round
Battle Chant1510AutomaticBonus ActionWhen you activate this Operator Skill, you may cast a Cantrip with a Casting Time of an Action as part of that Bonus Action.Instant
Close Quarters Casting105AutomaticBonus ActionYour Melee Spell Attacks have +2 Critical Range.3 Rounds
Crimson Eyes1510AutomaticReactionWhen you cast an Art using Arts Points, you may use this Operator Skill to lose Hit Points in intervals of 1d12. For each 1d12 you lose, one of the Arts Points you used to cast that Art is refunded.Instant
Cull2010AutomaticBonus ActionWhen you deal Damage to a Creature with less than half of their maximum Hit Points, you deal 1 additional die of Damage.2 Rounds
Destiny1510OffensiveActionYou may cast a damaging Cantrip you know as part of activating this Operator Skill; however, its Range becomes Self (20ft Cube), originating from you. When you cast a Cantrip as part of this Operator Skill, you may choose any number of Creatures within the area to be excluded from its effects. If the Cantrip involves a Spell Attack, make one Attack Roll and check it against the AC of all targets separately.Instant
Flashpoint100AutomaticBonus ActionWhen you cast an Art that affects a Sphere or Cube; the size of the affected area is increased by 10ft, and Creatures within 5ft of the center of the Area when the Art is cast have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against that Art.2 Rounds
Focus155AutomaticBonus ActionYou gain a +1 Bonus to your Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls.3 Rounds
Levitate155AutomaticActionChoose a Creature you can see within 30ft. That Creature must make a Strength Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failed Save, they are Restrained until the beginning of your next Turn. On a successful Save, its Speed is halved until the beginning of your next Turn.Instant
Magnet Force2010OffensiveBonus ActionLevitate a Melee Weapon you are carrying. As part of this Bonus Action, you may move that weapon up to 30ft and make a Melee Spell Attack against one Creature within 5 feet of it; if it hits, it deals 2d6 + your Spellcasting Modifier in Force Damage as opposed to the weapon’s normal Damage. On subsequent Rounds while the Skill is Active, you may use your Bonus Action to move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a Creature within 5 feet of it.5 Rounds
Meditation105AutomaticActionYou gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Character Level.Instant
Rebound100AutomaticReactionAfter you expend fewer than three Arts Points to cast an Art that can only target one Creature, you can immediately use this Operator Skill to cast that Art again as part of this Reaction; this ignores restrictions on casting multiple levelled Arts in one Turn and costs 1 fewer Arts Point, but you must target a different Creature.Instant
Shell Shock205AutomaticActionWhen you activate this Operator Skill, you can cast an Art you know with a Casting Time of an Action. After you do, choose a Creature that took Damage from that Art; they must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC or their Speed is reduced to 0 until the end of their next Turn.Instant
Within Reach1510AutomaticBonus ActionWhen you cast an Art that has a range of at least 5 feet, double the range of that Art. Alternatively, if the Art has a range of Touch, that range becomes 30ft instead.2 Rounds
You Shall Not Pass2010AutomaticActionYou create a wall of fire in a 10 foot cube originating from a point you can see within 60 feet. When a Creature enters the area during its Turn or begins its Turn there, it must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against either your Martial DC or Spell Save DC (your choice). On a failed Save, it takes 2d6 Fire Damage, or 4d6 if it has not lost any Hit Points. On a successful Save, it takes half as much Damage.3 Rounds
Advanced Caster Skills
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Amplification Field3015AutomaticBonus ActionYou project an aura in a 15-foot-radius sphere around yourself for the duration. Your Attacks against Creatures within this aura deal an additional 2d4 Force Damage.3 Rounds
Baptize the Blade3515OffensiveActionYou empower a weapon you are wielding. For the duration, your Attacks with that weapon deal additional Force Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you hit a Creature with more than half of their maximum Hit Points remaining using that weapon, that Attack instead deals additional Force Damage equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.5 Rounds
Crackling Mote3520AutomaticActionYou create a mote of Arts in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet for 10 minutes. A hostile Creature that moves within 10 feet of the mote or begins its Turn there makes a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failed Save, they take 20 Force Damage, or 10 on a successful Save. The mote disappears after it has dealt 60 Damage, after 10 minutes, or when you use this Skill again.Instant
EMP Eruption4020AutomaticActionYou release a burst of electrical Arts energy that fries circuits; Creatures of your choice within a 50-foot-radius Sphere centered on you must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Martial DC or Spell Save DC (your choice). On a failed Save, they take 3d6 Lightning Damage; on a successful Save, they take half as much Damage. If the Creature is a Construct (Machine) or otherwise has significant electrical components, on a failed Save they instead take 9d6 Lightning Damage and are Paralyzed until the end of their next Turn. On a successful Save, they take half as much Damage, and are Dazed until the end of their next Turn.Instant
Gentle Binding Gaze3015AutomaticActionWhen you Activate this Skill, and as a Bonus Action on subsequent Turns, you can choose a Creature that can see you within 60 feet; that Creature must succeed on a Charisma Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC or become Restrained for the duration of the Skill, bound up in your Arts. The Creature may reattempt the Saving Throw at the end of each of their Turns, ending the Condition on a success. Once a Creature has succeeded on this Saving Throw, it becomes immune to this effect for 1 hour.3 Rounds
Laser Focus2020AutomaticActionAs part of using this Skill, you may cast an Art with a Casting Time of Action, and that covers an Area of Effect (such as a Cone, Sphere, or Cube). The range and affected area of that Art is replaced with a Line originating from you, 120 feet in length and 5 foot in width, for that casting only. Creatures that have to make a Saving Throw against that Art this Turn have Disadvantage on that Saving Throw.Instant
Meandering Stars4030AutomaticActionA shower of Arts burst from you, raining like falling stars. Roll 1d6 for each Creature of your choice within 50 feet of you. On a result of 5 or 6, that Creature takes 4d8 Force Damage.Instant
Phantom Force4010AutomaticActionChoose a location you can see within 100 feet. All Creatures within a 20-foot Sphere centered on that point must make an Intelligence Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failed Save, they are trapped in your Nightmare until the end of their next Turn; a Creature in the Nightmare takes 2 Psychic Damage for each foot it moves, is Frightened of all other Creatures, and has Disadvantage on all Attacks it makes. A Creature in the Nightmare is not blinded, but the world appears as a horrific facsimile of the real world. On a successful Save, they are Dazed until the end of their next Turn. A Creature that is immune to the Frightened Condition is immune to this effect.Instant
Advanced Caster Skills Continued
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Precise Redirection4010OffensiveBonus ActionYou create an Arts Redirection Portal at a location you can see within 30 feet. The Portal is intangible, ethereal, and cannot be damaged. As a Bonus Action, you may cause your Portal to move up to 30 feet in a direction you choose. Once per Turn, when you cast a Cantrip, you may cast that Cantrip an additional time from your Portal (no Action required); you cast the Cantrip as if you were in the Portal’s space. Additionally, when you cast any levelled Art, you may cast it as if you were in the Portal’s Space.5 Rounds
Ring of Purgatory3015AutomaticActionChoose a friendly Creature you can see within 30-feet. For the duration, both you and that Creature projects destructive Arts in a 15-foot-radius around themselves. When a hostile Creature enters the area or begins their Turn there, they must make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC, taking 3d8 Force Damage on a failed Save, or half as much on a successful one. A Creature can only take this Damage once per Turn.3 Rounds
Salt the Wound3030AutomaticReactionWhen a Creature you can see within 100 feet of you gains a Status Condition as a result of a hostile action, you can use this Skill. The target Creature must make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC, taking 6d6 Necrotic Damage on a failed Save, or half as much on a successful Save.Instant
Storm's Wake4020AutomaticActionAs part of using this Skill, you may cast an non-Cantrip Art with a Casting Time of Action, does not require Concentration, and that covers an Area of Effect (such as a Cone, Sphere, or Cube). After that Art has been resolved, an Arts Storm appears at a point of your choice within the original Arts Area of Effect. The Arts Storm is a 15-foot-radius Sphere. A Creature that enters the Sphere during their Turn, or begins their Turn there, must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failed Save, they take 6d6 Damage, with the Damage Type being one of the Damage Types present on the original Art (your choice). On a successful Save, they take half as much. At the end of your Turn for the duration, the Storm moves 20 feet directly away from you.3 Rounds
Terrifying Force3020AutomaticActionYou may cast a damaging Art with a Casting Time of Action as part of using this Operator Skill; any hostile Creature that takes Damage from that Art, or is within 10 feet of a Creature that takes Damage from that Art, must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC or become Frightened of you until the end of their next Turn.Instant
Ultimatum4020OffensiveBonus ActionOnce per Turn, after you cast an Art, you release a damaging mote (no Action required) that seeks the hostile Creature with the fewest Hit Points within 60 feet; make a Ranged Spell Attack against that Creature. On a Hit, that Creature takes 2d10 Force Damage.3 Rounds
Elite Caster Skills
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Desolate Echo8030AutomaticActionAs part of using this Skill, you may cast an Art with a Casting Time of an Action. After you have cast that Art, an Echo appears within 5 feet of a Creature affected by the original Art (your choice if there are multiple Creatures). The Echo is a visible but intangible orb of Originium Arts. When a hostile Creature enters a 20-foot-radius around the Echo, and is not behind Full Cover from the Echo , they must make a Strength Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failed Save, they take 6d6 Damage, with the Damage Type being one of the Damage Types present on the original Art (your choice), are pulled 15 feet towards the Echo, and have their Movement Speed reduced by half (rounding down). On a successful Save, they take half as much Damage, and suffer no other effects. A Creature only needs to make this Save once per Turn.5 Rounds
Exclusion Zone6530AutomaticActionAll Creatures within a 50ft Cone originating from you must make a Strength Saving Throw as a wave of gravitic energy washes over them. On a failed Save, they take 5d12 Force Damage, and pushed to the closest edge of the Cone. On a successful Save, they take half as much Damage and are not pushed. For the duration, when a Creature enters the area or begins its Turn there, it must succeed on a Strength Saving Throw or its Speed is reduced to 0 for the Duration. Ranged Attacks that would pass through the area automatically fail.3 Rounds
In Tune5030AutomaticActionOriginium Arts permeates your very form, temporarily ascending you to a higher state. For the duration, Attacks made against you are made at Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on all Saving Throws. Furthermore, whenever you roll a d20, if the natural result of the dice is 9 or less, treat it as if you had rolled a 10.5 Rounds
Leyline6530AutomaticActionFor the duration, your Movement Speed is reduced to 0 and cannot be increased. However, you gain a +3 Bonus to your Spell Attack Rolls, your Spell Save DC is increased by 3, and when you roll to determine the Damage or Hit Points restored of an Art, if the result is less than half of the maximum, it becomes equal to half of the maximum. You may end this Skill early as an Action during your Turn.5 Rounds
Lock-On6520AutomaticBonus ActionChoose a Creature you can see; for the duration, your Arts that target only one Creature ignore the effects of Half Cover, Three Quarter Cover, and Full Cover if they are targeting that Creature. In addition, you no longer require Line of Sight to that Creature to target them with Arts, even if the Art would normally require it, so long as they are within the range.5 Rounds
Maximise8030AutomaticActionAs part of using this Skill, you may cast a Damaging Art. This Turn, when that Art would deal Damage, do not roll; it instead deals the maximum possible Damage for that Art.Instant
Power Battery8030AutomaticBonus ActionRoll 2d10 and discard one die with the lowest result. You immediately recover that many Arts Points. This allows you to exceed your maximum Arts Points, however, any excess Arts Points are lost when you complete a Long Rest.Instant
Punishment8035AutomaticActionOnce on each of your Turns (no Action required), choose a Creature you can see within 60ft. That Creature must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC, taking 3d10 Lightning Damage on a failed Save, or half as much on a successful Save.5 Rounds
Scorched Earth6530AutomaticActionAs part of activating this Operator Skill, you may cast an Art with a Casting Time of Action, does not require Concentration, and that covers an Area of Effect (such as a Cone, Sphere, or Cube). For this casting only, that Art is considered to require Concentration. At the beginning of each of your Turns, the effects of that Art are reapplied to the same location as if you had cast it again; Damage dealt by these secondary “casts” ignore Resistances. The Art ends when you lose Concentration, or the duration of this Skill ends.3 Rounds
Elite Caster Skills Continued
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Supreme Acuity8020AutomaticNo Action RequiredFor the duration of this Operator Skill, you may Concentrate on two Arts at the same time. If you fail a Constitution Saving Throw to maintain Concentration, you drop Concentration on one Art; you choose which one.Until Long Rest
Touch the Heavens5030AutomaticBonus ActionThe next Art you cast this Turn that has a Range of 10 feet or more has its Range multiplied by 10. If the Spell affects a Line or Cone Area of Effect, the length of those areas is doubled.1 Round
Wolfpack5030AutomaticBonus ActionYou place a Wolfmark Curse on a Creature you can see within 100 feet of you for the Duration. Creatures with a Wolfmark take 1d8 Psychic Damage when they take Damage from your Arts. Once on each of your Turns, you can consume a Wolfmark on a Creature you can see (no Action required) to cause them to have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your Arts this Turn. When a Wolfmark is consumed in this way, or a Creature with a Wolfmark falls to 0 Hit Points, you may use a Bonus Action during this Turn or your next Turn to place a Wolfmark Curse on two Creatures of your choice within 100 feet of you for the Duration.10 Rounds

Armoured CasterYou gain Proficiency with Light Armour.While you are wearing Light Armour, you have a +1 Modifier to Dexterity Saving Throws.
Clean SweepOnce per Round, when you roll to determine the Damage you deal to a Creature with more than half of its maximum Hit Points, you deal 1 additional die of Damage to that Creature.You now deal 2 additional dice of Damage instead.
EnforcerCreatures with less than 50% of their maximum Hit Points remaining have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your Arts.If one of your Arts or Operator Skills reduces a Creature to Hit Points equal to or less than your Character Level, they die.

Your Attacks against Creatures with that Creature Type deal additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.You gain a Bonus to Attack Rolls against Creatures with that Creature Type equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
LuckyYou have two Luck Points. You can spend 1 Luck Point to either grant yourself Advantage on a d20 roll, or grant an enemy Disadvantage on an Attack Roll against you. You regain all expended Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.Your maximum Luck Points becomes equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
SpellbladeWhenever you finish a Long Rest, you can touch one weapon that you are Proficient with. When you Attack with that weapon, you can use your Spellcasting Ability Modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the Attack and Damage Rolls. Additionally, that Weapon gains the Casting Unit Property. This benefit lasts until you finish a Long Rest.When casting Arts using the weapon you chose, you no longer need to perform Somatic Components for those Arts. In addition, Damage from that Weapon is considered to be Arts Damage.
Staggering ForceWhen you hit a Creature with a Spell Attack, or a Creature fails a Saving Throw against your Art during your Turn, you reduce that Creature's Speed by 10 ft. until the end of their next Turn. A Creature can only have its Speed reduced in this way once per Round.It is no longer required for it to be your Turn for this Talent to slow a Creature's Speed.
ToughYour Hit Point Maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your Character Level. Unconventional TacticsWhen you deal Damage to a Creature as a result of a Melee Spell Attack, you deal an additional dice of Damage.Your Melee Spell Attacks have +1 Critical Range.
UnshakeableYou have Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws to maintain Concentration on Arts.When a Creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you, you may cast an Art as a Reaction, instead of making a Melee Attack. The Art must have a Casting Time of an Action, and target only that Creature.
Unwavering AccuracyYou no longer have Disadvantage when making Ranged Spell Attacks while a hostile Creature is within 5 feet of you. Additionally, when you cast an Art with a Range of 10 feet or more, that Range is increased by 30 feet.When you make a Spell Attack Roll, you may ignore the effects of Half and Three-Quarters Cover.
Advanced Caster Talents
NameEffectModule Effect
All I KnowWhen you cast a Damaging Art, you may expend 3 AP as a Bonus Action to cause that Art to ignore Resistances and Damage Reduction.You are no longer required to expend your Bonus Action to use this Feature.
Arts WardWhen a Creature you can see within 30 feet of you would take Arts Damage, you can use this Feature as a Reaction. You can expend a number of Arts Points up to a value equal to your Proficiency Bonus; roll a d6 for each Arts Points expended in this way. The Arts Damage taken by that Creature is reduced by the total value rolled.You roll 2d6 for each Art Point expended instead.
Cold StartWhen you roll Initiative, you gain 5 SP.You instead gain 10 SP.
DivinationWhenever you roll Initiative, roll 1d4. Depending on the result, you gain a bonus until the end of that combat: 1: +1 to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls. 2: +2 to Damage Rolls. 3: +15 Temporary Hit Points. 4: +10ft Speed.The bonuses increase to +2, +4, +30, and +20ft respectively.
Elemental SpecialistChoose an Arts Damage Type. You become Resistant to that Damage Type, and when you roll to determine Damage dealt by that Damage Type, you may reroll any result of 1, but must use the new result.Whenever you roll to determine the Damage Dealt of your chosen Damage Type by one of your Arts, you may roll an additional die of that Damage.
Energy RedirectionChoose an Arts Damage Type; you gain Resistance to that Damage Type. When you finish a Long Rest, you may change the Damage Type you have chosen. Additionally, as a Reaction when you take Damage that you are Resistant or Immune to, choose a Creature you can see within 60 feet to direct Damage of the same Type towards them. That Creature must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC, taking 4d8 Damage on a failed Save, or half as much on a successful one.You may choose two Damage Types for this Feature, as opposed to just one.
Extra AttackYou can Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack Action.You have a +1 to Attack and Damage Rolls for non-Spell Attacks.
Finishing TouchWhen you reduce a Creature to 0 Hit Points, you gain 1 Quickening. For each Quickening you have, you deal 1 additional Damage with all Attacks and Arts. Your maximum Quickening is five, and you lose all Quickening upon finishing a Long Rest.When you reduce a Creature to 0 Hit Points, you gain 2 Quickening instead of 1.
Flash of InsightWhen you roll Damage for an Art, if any result on a dice is the maximum value that could be rolled on that dice, you may roll 1 additional die and add it to the total Damage. You may only do so once per Art.You may now roll up to 2 additional dice per Art.
Hammer and AnvilOnce per Turn, when you hit a Creature within 5 feet of an allied Creature with a Ranged Attack, that Attack deals additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.The range at which this Feature is effective is increased to 10 feet.
JumpstartThe Start SP of your Operator Skills is increased by 5.The Start SP of your Operator Skills is increased by 10 instead.
Knowledge is PowerAfter you roll a Saving Throw, you may add a bonus equal to your Spellcasting Ability Modifier to the result of that Saving Throw; you may do this after you have seen the result of the roll, but before the DM tells you if the roll has passed or failed. You may use this Feature twice, and regain all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.You now regain use of this Feature after completing a Short or Long Rest.
LieutenantYou learn two Instructions of your Choice from the Instructor Branch of the Guard Class. Furthermore, you gain 2 Instruction Dice, which are d6s. While you have Instruction Dice remaining, you may take the Help Action to aid an ally in attacking a Creature as a Bonus Action, and the target of that Attack can be within 30ft of you, rather than within 5ft. However, if you do so, you must use an Instruction as part of that Help Action. You regain all expended Instruction Dice upon completing a Long Rest.You gain a third Instruction Dice, and your Instruction Dice become d8s.
Lone JourneyAt the end of your Turn, if there are no other Creatures within 10 feet of you, you have Damage Resistance against all Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.Allied Creatures are no longer considered to be Creatures within 10 feet of you for the purpose of this Feature.
Reliable TalentWhen you make a Check using a Skill you are Proficient in, treat any result on the d20 of 8 or less as an 8.You cannot have Disadvantage on any Check using a Skill or Tool you are Proficient with.
Advanced Caster Talents Continued
NameEffectModule Effect
Scattering SparkOnce per Turn, when you roll Damage for an Art, if at least one result on a dice is the maximum value that could be rolled on that dice, you create a explosion of energy. All Hostile Creatures within 15 feet of the location the Art was cast from must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC, taking 4d4 Damage on a failed Save or half as much on a successful one. The Damage Type is the same as one present on the original Art (your choice if there are multiple).This Feature is no longer Restricted to once per Turn, and the Damage is increased to 6d4. However, this Feature is limited to once per Art.
Second Strike ProtocolIf you have expended Arts Points during your Turn, you can make a Ranged Spell Attack against a Creature you can see within 60 feet as a Bonus Action. On a hit, that Creature takes 1d6 + your Spellcasting Ability Modifier Force Damage.The Force Damage is increased to 2d6.
ShelterYou gain a Barrier that shatters whenever you take Damage from a Creature. When the Barrier shatters, it halves the Damage you take from the triggering instance of Damage. The Barrier reforms upon finishing a Long Rest, or you can expend 3 Arts Points as a Bonus Action to reform it.When the Barrier shatters, it additionally grants you Resistance to the Damage Types present on that instance of Damage until the end of the Turn.
ThresherWhen you deal Damage with an Art to a Creature who has any Damage Reduction against Physical Damage only, that Creature takes additional Damage from that Art equal to half of that Damage Reduction (rounding up).Your Arts deal additional Damage to Creatures you have already Damaged with an Art this Turn equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Trial of Thorns6530DefensiveActionWhen a hostile Creature within 30 feet of you would make an Attack against a Creature that is not you, you can use your Reaction to force the attacking Creature to make a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Martial DC; on a failed Save, they must Attack you instead if they are able, and cannot Attack otherwise. Once during each Creature's Turn, when a Creature makes an Attack against you, you can move half of your Speed towards that Creature and make a Melee Attack against them if possible (no Action required).3 Rounds
Basic Defender Talents
NameEffectModule Effect
AlacrityYour Speed increases by 10 feet.When you take the Dash Action, you add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armour Class until the end of the Turn.
AlertYou gain a Bonus to your Initiative Rolls equal to your Proficiency Bonus.You have Advantage on Initiative Rolls.
Back-to-BackIf there is another allied Creature within 15ft of you with this Ability, you may add +1 to all Attack and Damage Rolls you make.If there is another allied Creature within 15ft of you with this Ability, you gain 2 DR against all Damage.
CounterstrikeAttacks you make when it is not your Turn deal additional Damage equal to the Ability Modifier you used for that Attack.Attacks you make when it is not your Turn are made at Advantage.
Elemental ResistanceChoose an Arts Damage Type; you become Resistant to that Damage Type.You may choose a second Arts Damage Type to become Resistant to.
FortitudeWhen another Creature rolls to cause you to regain Hit Points, they roll 1 additional dice; you recover additional Hit Points equal to the result of this dice.Creatures rolling to restore Hit Points to you roll 2 additional dice instead.
Gatekeeper of LifeWhen dice are rolled to determine the amount of Hit Points restored to a Creature within 10 feet of you, you can expend your Reaction to reroll any number of the dice; you must use the new results.When you use this Feature, you may choose to use either the original or new result of a dice you rerolled.
Hunter (X)Choose one from: Aberration, Beast, Celestials, Construct, Fiends, Monstrosity, Plants, Undead. Your Attacks against Creatures with that Creature Type deal additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.You gain a Bonus to Attack Rolls against Creatures with that Creature Type equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Interlocking ShieldsOther Creatures that are benefitting from your Shelter Action gain DR against Physical Damage equal to half your Proficiency Bonus (this effect is not cumulative with other sources of this Feature).The granted Damage Reduction is now against all Damage.
Lasting StingCreatures who you have dealt Poison Damage to during a Turn take 2d10 Poison Damage at the end of the Turn.Additionally, at the end of the Turn, they must pass a DC15 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer the Poisoned Condition until the end of their next Turn.
LuckyYou have two Luck Points. You can spend 1 Luck Point to either grant yourself Advantage on a d20 roll, or grant an enemy Disadvantage on an Attack Roll against you. You regain all expended Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.Your maximum Luck Points becomes equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Martial AcumenYou gain a Fighting Style from one of the Styles available to the Guard Class.As a Bonus Action, you may grant a Weapon you are wielding the Couch, Deadly, or Crush (5) Property until the beginning of your next Turn.
Miracle GuardIf the Natural Result of an Attack Roll against you is less than 1 + your Proficiency Bonus , that Attack misses regardless of the overall result.The threshold for Attacks to miss you becomes 3 + your Proficiency Bonus.
OverhealWhenever you are healed by another Creature, and the healing you receive is greater than the number of Hit Points you are missing, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the difference, up to a maximum of 20.The temporary Hit Points you receive from this Ability no longer has a maximum value.
ParryWhen you are hit by an Attack while you have a Melee Weapon or Shield equipped, you may use your Reaction to increase your AC by 1d4 for the duration of that Attack, possibly causing that Attack to miss. If you also have the Defensive Fighting Style, your AC is increased by 2d4 instead.The d4 is improved one step to d6.
Power PlantWhen you take Arts Damage from a hostile Creature, you gain 3 Skill Points.You gain 6 Skill Points instead.
RefreshmentOnce per Turn, when you restore Hit Points to a Creature, you can cause that Creature to gain 3 Skill Points.You grant 6 Skill Points instead.
Sapping GuardWhen a Creature hits you with a Melee Attack, you can force them (no Action required) to pass a Constitution Saving Throw against your Martial DC or be Dazed until the end of their next Turn. Once you have used this Feature, you may not do so again until you have completed a Short Rest.You can now use this Feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and regain all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.
SentinelWhen you hit a Creature with an Opportunity Attack, you reduce that Creature's Speed to 0 until the end of the Turn.The first Opportunity Attack you make each Round does not consume your Reaction.
Stress InversionWhile you have less than half of your maximum Hit Points, you gain Damage Resistance against Physical Damage equal to half of your Proficiency Bonus, rounding up.The granted Damage Reduction is now against all Damage.
ToughYour Hit Point Maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your Character Level. When you gain a Character Level thereafter, your Hit Point Maximum increases by an additional two points.Whenever you expend a Hit Dice to restore your Hit Points, you recover additional Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Advanced Defender Talents
NameEffectModule Effect
Charging UpWhenever you roll Initiative, you gain a +1 Bonus to your Attack Rolls, and +1 DR against all Damage, up to a maximum of +3. This bonus is lost whenever you complete a Long Rest.The maximum bonus is now +5.
Dig InIf you did not move during your last Turn, you gain the benefit of Half Cover at the beginning of your Turn. This benefit is lost if you move.While you are benefitting from this Feature, you gain Physicial DR equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounding up.
DominusOnce per Short Rest, as a Bonus Action, you can force hostile Creatures within a 30-foot cone originating from you to make a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Martial DC. On a failed Save, they are Frightened of you until the end of their next Turn. On a successful Save, their Movement Speed is reduced by half (rounding up) until the end of their next Turn.Your Attacks against Frightened Creatures deal an additional die of Damage.
Feedback ArmourWhen a Creature hits you with a Melee Attack while you are wearing Armour, you can use your Reaction to force them to take 2d4 Lightning Damage.The Lightning Damage is increased to 4d4.
Hidden TechniqueYou gain 2 Grit Points, and learn 3 Basic Brawler Techniques of your choice from the Brawler Branch of the Guard Class. You recover all expended Grit whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest.You gain 1 additional Grit Point, and learn 2 more Techniques.
ImmortalWhen you would take Damage, you can expend and roll one of your Hit Dice as a Reaction; you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the amount rolled + your Constitution Modifier. You can use this Feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and regain all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.This Feature no longer requires use of your Reaction.
JumpstartThe Start SP of your Operator Skills is increased by 5.The Start SP of your Operator Skills is increased by 10 instead.
KingslayerYou have Damage Resistance against all Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus when that Damage comes from an Elite or Leader Creature.Your Attacks against Elite or Leader Creatures deal an additional 1d8 Force Damage.
LieutenantYou learn two Instructions of your Choice from the Instructor Branch of the Guard Class. Furthermore, you gain 2 Instruction Dice, which are d6s. While you have Instruction Dice remaining, you may take the Help Action to aid an ally in attacking a Creature as a Bonus Action, and the target of that Attack can be within 30ft of you, rather than within 5ft. However, if you do so, you must use an Instruction as part of that Help Action. You regain all expended Instruction Dice upon completing a Long Rest.You gain a third Instruction Dice, and your Instruction Dice become d8s.
Mirror MoveWhen a Creature you can see within 30 feet deals Arts Damage to you, you can expend your Reaction to deal 2d8 Force Damage to that Creature. You can use this Feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and regain all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.The Force Damage is increased to 4d8.
OpportunistAttacks you make against Creatures with reduced Speed deal additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.You may also deal this additional Damage against Creatures that have any detrimental Status Condition.
Part-Time InventorYou gain the Equipment Modification Feature of the Inventor Specialist. However, your maximum number of Inventions is 1, and you cannot apply any Modification marked as Dangerous.Your maximum number of Inventions becomes 2.
Razor's EdgeWhile you are Dying, the first Struggle Attack you make each Turn costs 1 less Mettle (to a minimum of 0). Additionally, the Mettle Cost of the Stabilise Death's Door Action is reduced by 1 for you for each time you deal Damage while Dying. This reduction is lost when you are no longer Dying.While you are Dying, your Attacks deal additional Weapon Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Reliable TalentWhen you make a Check using a Skill you are Proficient in, treat any result on the d20 of 8 or less as an 8.You cannot have Disadvantage on any Check using a Skill or Tool you are Proficient with.

20th Level: Annihilation Protocol

Limits are made to be broken; yours have been shattered, never to reform. When you roll Initiative and have no uses of Unrelenting remaining, you regain one use.

Once you have used this Feature, you may not do so again until you have finished a Long Rest.The amount of Temporary Hit Points you gain from this Feature is doubled.
Snowball EffectWhen you reduce a Creature to 0 Hit Points, or a Creature you damaged on your last Turn is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may reroll the result of the next Saving Throw you fail. This bonus is lost after completing a Short or Long Rest.If you still fail a Saving Throw after rerolling it with this Feature, you do not gain any Conditions as a result. You still suffer any other effects or Damage.
Spiritual DestructionAs a Bonus Action, you can cause your next Attack to Silence Creatures hit by it until the end of their next Turn. You may use this Ability a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and regain all uses upon finishing a Long Rest.If a Creature Silenced by you is concentrating on any Art, its Concentration immediately ends. Additionally, if they have any Ability that triggers upon their death or reaching 0 Hit Points, they do not activate if they are Silenced by this Feature at the time.
Tactical MindWhen you roll a d20, you may reroll that die and add 1d10 to the result of the roll as a Reaction. Once you have used this Feature, you must finish a Long Rest before you can use it again.You now regain use of this Feature when you complete a Short Rest.
Unnatural RegenerationOnce per Long Rest, as a Reaction when you take Damage, you may activate this Ability. For the next minute, at the beginning of each of your Turns, you recover Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.The amount of Hit Points restored is equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus instead.
WarbreedWhen an enemy within 15 feet of you is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may expend 1 Hit Dice to roll that dice and recover Hit Points equal to the amount rolled + your Constitution Modifier.Once per Short Rest, you may use this Feature without expending a Hit Dice.
WavebreakerIf there are three or more hostile Creatures within 15 feet of you, you have Advantage on Melee Attack Rolls.If there are three or more hostile Creatures within 15 feet of you, those Creatures have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you.

migrated.name: Liberator: 17th Level: Révolution
migrated.content:
17th Level: Révolution

You have become an ideological avatar, the distilled essence of all you believe in. You have held your tongue for long enough.

As an Action during your Turn, you can release your Liberty in a singular powerful burst; all of your Liberty is expended. All hostile Creatures within 20 feet must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Martial DC or take 1d12 Force Damage for every Liberty expended in this way. You then gain the following benefits for the next 10 minutes.

Champion of the Worthy. Once on each of your Turns, if you have not used it that Turn you may use your Guide the Masses Feature without expending an Action. If you do so, you generate Liberty as if you had done so as an Action, and you may not do use that Feature as an Action that Turn.

Shield of Belief. At the beginning of each of your Turns, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Guard Level.

Time to Act. Whenever you gain or are refunded Liberty, you gain one more.

Once you have used this Feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a Long Rest.

Liberator Basic Skills
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Defender of the Worthy150AutomaticActionWhen you activate this Operator Skill, you gain 1d8 Temporary Hit Points for each Liberty you consumed this Turn. While this Skill is Active, when a Creature within 15 feet of you is attacked, you may move to them and replace them as the target of the Attack as a Reaction. If you still have Temporary Hit Points after the Attack, you regain your Reaction, and can make a Melee Attack against the attacking Creature.3 Rounds
Esoteric Bladework300AutomaticBonus ActionYour Reach is increased by 10 feet, and when you make a Melee Attack during your Turn, you may repeat that Attack against another Creature within your Reach (no Action required). This additional Attack cannot generate further Attacks.5 Rounds
Flash of Light100AutomaticBonus ActionThe next Melee Attack you make is made with Advantage, and the additional Damage you gained from expending Liberty is doubled for that Attack. Additionally, if the Attack misses, the target Creature still takes half of that Attack's Damage.1 Attack
Sweep Away200AutomaticActionAll Creatures in a 180-degree, 30-foot cone originating from you must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Martial DC, taking 4d8 Slashing Damage on a failed Save, or half as much on a successful Save.Instant
Liberator Advanced Skills
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Edge of Fate4015AutomaticBonus ActionYour Arts coalesce into a spectral floating weapon within a space you can see with 100 feet. When you activate this Opeartor Skill, and as a Bonus Action on subsequent Turns, you can cause the weapon to move up to 20 feet in a direction of your choice, and make a Melee Attack using the weapon against a target within 5 feet of it; you can use your Dexerity Modifier instead of Strength for the Attack and Damage Rolls, and you are considered to be Proficient with it. On a hit, the weapon deals 2d10 + your Ability Modifier Force Damage. The Critical Range of Attacks with this Weapon is increased by 1.3 Rounds
From on High4015AutomaticActionEvery other Creature within a 25-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centred on you must make a Strength Saving Throw against your Martial DC. On a failed Save, they take 3d10 Force Damage, and their Speed is reduced to 0 until the end of their next Turn. Additionally, at the end of their next Turn, they take 3d10 Force Damage. If they are flying when they fail the Save, they are forced directly down to the ground, taking falling Damage as appropriate, and are Stunned. On a successful Save, they take half as much Damage, and their Speed is only halved.Instant
Heaven Piercer4015AutomaticActionChoose a Creature you can see within 50 feet; you dash forward in a straight line towards that Creature until they are within your Reach. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. After you do so, make a Melee Attack against that Creature with Advantage; you gain a +5 bonus to this Attack Roll, but the Attack deals no Damage at this stage. Subtract the Creature's Armour Class from the result of the Attack Roll, and divide the resulting value by two, rounding up; the target Creature takes hits from the weapon used for the Attack Roll equal to the remaining value.Instant
Overrun4015AutomaticActionEvery Creature within a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Martial DC; Creatures who are within your Reach have Disadvantage on this Saving Throw, and take double Damage from this Operator Skill. On a failed Save, they take 3d10 Slashing Damage and are Frightened of you. While Frightened, they may attempt this Saving Throw again at the beginning of each of their Turns, ending the Condition on a successful Save. On a successful Save, they take half as much Damage, and are not Frightened.Instant
Liberator Elite Skills
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Fortress5030AutomaticActionYou project an aura with your Arts to defend your allies and punish your foes. Allied Creatures within 30 feet of you gain a bonus to Saving Throws equal to the amount of Liberty you expended to activate this Skill. Additionally, all Attacks against them have Disadvantage, and cannot have Advantage. When a Creature misses an Attack against a Creature within 30 feet of you, you may use your Reaction to deal 1d10 Force Damage to that Creature for every two Liberty you consumed when activating this Operator Skill.5 Rounds
Glory8030AutomaticActionWhen you Activate this Skill, and as an Action on each of your subsequent Turns; all Creatures within a 60-foot cone originating from you must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Martial DC. On a failed save, they take 5d12 Radiant Damage, or half as much on a successful one.3 Rounds
Silence6520AutomaticActionAll Creatures within a 25-foot-radius Sphere centred on you (but excluding you) must make a Strength Saving Throw against your Martial DC. On a failed Save, they take 2d10 Slashing Damage, and are pulled 15 feet directly towards you. On a successful save, they take half as much Damage, and are not pulled. Then, all Creatures within 10 feet of you take 1d10 Slashing Damage for each Liberty you consumed when activating this Operator Skill.Instant
Storm6520AutomaticActionChoose up to three different Creatures you can see within 100 feet. You may make a Melee Attack against each of those Creatures as if they were within your Reach; the additional Damage you gained by consuming Liberty is doubled for those Attacks. If a Creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points by these Attacks, you may choose an additional Creature to Attack, up to a maximum total of six Attacks; you cannot Attack the same Creature more than once. Afterwards, you may then teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a Creature you Attacked as part of this Operator Skill.Instant

NameEffectModule Effect
AlacrityYour Speed increases by 10 feet.When you take the Dash Action, you add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armour Class until the end of the Turn.
AlertYou gain a Bonus to your Initiative Rolls equal to your Proficiency Bonus.You have Advantage on Initiative Rolls.
All Out AttackIf you did not make an Attack or deal Damage during your last Turn, your next Attack deals 1d10 additional Damage.The additional Damage is increased to 2d10.
Back-to-BackIf there is another allied Creature within 15ft of you with this Ability, you may add +1 to all Attack and Damage Rolls you make.If there is another allied Creature within 15ft of you with this Ability, you gain 2 DR against all Damage.
Bird HunterYour Ranged Attacks against Creatures not touching the ground deal additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Modifier.If a Creature you can see moves using a Flying Speed within the Normal Range of a weapon you are wielding, you can expend your Reaction to make an Attack with that weapon against that Creature. You can use this Feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and regain all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.
Clean SweepOnce per Round, when you roll to determine the Damage you deal to a Creature with more than half of its maximum Hit Points, you deal 1 additional die of Damage to that Creature.This Feature is no longer limited to once per Round.
Critical EdgeYour Critical Range is increased by 1.You can roll one additional Damage die when determining the extra Damage for a Critical Hit.
Fragile FocusIf you have not taken any Damage since the start of your last Turn, when you deal Damage to a Creature you can deal 1d8 additional Damage to that Creature; you can only deal this additional Damage once per Turn.If you have not taken any Damage since the start of your last Turn, you treat any result of a 1 or 2 you roll on a Damage die as a 3.

Illuminant EyesYou gain 30 feet of Darkvision; if you already have Darkvision, it is increased by 30 feet. Additionally, once per Short Rest as an Action, you may double the range of your Darkvision for 1 minute.When you use this Feature as an Action, your Darkvision triples instead of doubling..
Lasting StingCreatures who you have dealt Poison Damage to during a Turn take 2d10 Poison Damage at the end of the Turn.Additionally, at the end of the Turn, they must pass a DC15 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer the Poisoned Condition until the end of their next Turn.
LuckyYou have two Luck Points. You can spend 1 Luck Point to either grant yourself Advantage on a d20 roll, or grant an enemy Disadvantage on an Attack Roll against you. You regain all expended Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.Your maximum Luck Points becomes equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Maximum Muzzle VelocityYour Ranged Weapon Attacks against Creatures within 30 feet of you gain the Crush (4) Property. Advanced Marksman Talents
NameEffectModule Effect
Alpha StrikeThe first time you deal Damage to a Creature with an Attack, that Attack deals 1d12 additional Weapon Damage. It is considered to be the first time you hit a Creature if you have rolled Initiative since the last time you hit them with an Attack.The additional Damage becomes 2d12.
AmbushAfter you roll Initiative, you deal 1 additional dice of Damage with your Attacks until the end of your next Turn.This additional Damage now applies to all Damage you deal, not just Attacks.
CrossfireDuring your Turn, you have Advantage on your first Ranged Attack against each Creature that has had a Ranged Attack made against it by another Creature since the end of your last Turn.Your Ranged Attacks now have Advantage against Creatures that have had a Ranged Attack made against them by another Creature since the end of your last Turn.
Cycle of Life and DeathIf you have reduced a Creature to 0 Hit Points while your Operator Skill is Active, you gain 10 SP at the end of that Skill.You gain 20 SP instead.
Danger SenseWhile you are conscious, you have Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against effects you can see.Invisible Creatures no longer have Advantage on Attack Rolls against you, and you can no longer be Suprised while Conscious.
Dig InIf you did not move during your last Turn, you gain the benefit of Half Cover at the beginning of your Turn. This benefit is lost if you move.While you are benefitting from this Feature, you gain Physicial DR equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounding up.
Eagle EyesYou have have a +5 Bonus to Perception and Investigation Checks based on sight, and as long as you can see, your Passive Percpetion and Investigation are increased by 5.Creatures do not have Advantage on Attacks against you as a result of being unseen, and you can now see Invisible Creatures within 30 feet of you.
Graceful ShadowWhen you take the Dodge Action, you may make one Weapon Attack as part of that Action.When you take the Dodge Action, the first time before your next Turn that you would take Damage from a hostile Creature, that Damage is halved.
Hammer and AnvilOnce per Turn, when you hit a Creature within 5 feet of an allied Creature with a Ranged Attack, that Attack deals additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.The range at which this Feature is effective is increased to 10 feet.
Help YourselfWhen you hit a Creature that has Physical Damage Reduction with an Attack, you steal 1 of their Damage Reduction, reducing their Damage Reduction by 1 and increasing yours by 1. At the end of your Turn, if you have not hit a Creature with an Attack, you lose any Damage Reduction you gained from this Feature, and it is returned to the Creatures you stole it from.The amount of Damage Reduction you steal when you hit a Creature with an Attack is increased to 2.
JumpstartThe Start SP of your Operator Skills is increased by 5.The Start SP of your Operator Skills is increased by 10 instead.
KingslayerYou have Damage Resistance against all Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus when that Damage comes from an Elite or Leader Creature.Your Attacks against Elite or Leader Creatures deal an additional 1d8 Force Damage.
LieutenantYou learn two Instructions of your Choice from the Instructor Branch of the Guard Class. Furthermore, you gain 2 Instruction Dice, which are d6s. While you have Instruction Dice remaining, you may take the Help Action to aid an ally in attacking a Creature as a Bonus Action, and the target of that Attack can be within 30ft of you, rather than within 5ft. However, if you do so, you must use an Instruction as part of that Help Action. You regain all expended Instruction Dice upon completing a Long Rest.You gain a third Instruction Dice, and your Instruction Dice become d8s.
Lone JourneyAt the end of your Turn, if there are no other Creatures within 10 feet of you, you have Damage Resistance against all Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.Allied Creatures are no longer considered to be Creatures within 10 feet of you for the purpose of this Feature.
One MomentWhile your Skill is Active, when you deal Damage to a Creature during your Turn, that Creature takes 1d6 Force Damage.The Force Damage taken is increased to 1d10.

Weighted ShotsThe first time you deal Damage to a Creature with an Attack, that Creature's Movement Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the end of their Turn. 20th Level: Chosen of Asclepius

Whenever you would roll to determine the amount of Hit Points you restore to a Creature, you can choose not to roll, and instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring 2d6 Hit Points to a Creature, you restore 12.

Basic Medic Skills
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Artseeker1010OffensiveBonus ActionRanged Spell Attack Rolls you make this Turn are made with Advantage, and ignore the benefits of Half and Three-Quarters Cover.1 Round
Battle Chant1510AutomaticBonus ActionWhen you activate this Operator Skill, you may cast a Cantrip with a Casting Time of an Action as part of that Bonus Action.Instant
Cull2010AutomaticBonus ActionWhen you deal Damage to a Creature with less than half of their maximum Hit Points, you deal 1 additional die of Damage.2 Rounds
Emergency Aid1515AutomaticReactionWhen an allied Creature within 60 feet that you can see takes Damage, you can use this Operator Skill; you may cast an Art from the Healing Arts Pool with a Casting Time of 1 Action as part of this Reaction, but must target the triggering Creature.Instant
Empathic Rejuvenation1510OffensiveBonus ActionWhen you hit a Creature with an Attack, choose one allied Creature within 15 feet of yourself; that Creature regains Hit Points equal to your Spellcasting Ability Modifier.3 Rounds
Flashpoint100AutomaticBonus ActionWhen you cast an Art that affects a Sphere or Cube; the size of the affected area is increased by 10ft, and Creatures within 5ft of the centre of the Area when the Art is cast have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against that Art.2 Rounds
Magnet Force2010OffensiveBonus ActionLevitate a Melee Weapon you are carrying. As part of this Bonus Action, you may move that weapon up to 30ft and make a Melee Spell Attack against one Creature within 5 feet of it; if it hits, it deals 2d6 + your Spellcasting Modifier in Force Damage as opposed to the weapon’s normal Damage. On subsequent Rounds while the Skill is Active, you may use your Bonus Action to move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a Creature within 5 feet of it.5 Rounds
Mark Prey1515AutomaticBonus ActionChoose a Creature that you can see; the first time each Turn that Creature is hit by an Attack, it takes 1d4 additional Damage. A Creature cannot be affected by more than one Mark Prey at a time.3 Rounds
Meditation105AutomaticActionYou gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Character Level.Instant
Focus155AutomaticBonus ActionYou gain a +1 Bonus to your Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls.3 Rounds
Levitate155AutomaticActionChoose a Creature you can see within 30ft. That Creature must make a Strength Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failed Save, they are Restrained until the beginning of your next Turn. On a successful Save, its Speed is halved until the beginning of your next Turn.Instant
Placebo Effect2015AutomaticActionChoose a Creature you can see within 50 feet that has a negative Status Condition, and choose one such Status Condition on that Creature. That Status Condition is then removed, and all hostile Creatures within 10 feet of that Creature must succeed on a Charisma Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC or suffer that Status Condition; they may reattempt this Saving Throw at the end of each of their Turns, ending the effect on a success.Instant
Within Reach1510AutomaticBonus ActionWhen you cast an Art that has a range of at least 5 feet, double the range of that Art. Alternatively, if the Art has a range of Touch, that range becomes 30ft instead.2 Rounds
You Shall Not Pass2010AutomaticActionYou create a wall of fire in a 10 foot cube originating from a point you can see within 60 feet. When a Creature enters the area during its Turn or begins its Turn there, it must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against either your Martial DC or Spell Save DC (your choice). On a failed Save, it takes 2d6 Fire Damage, or 4d6 if it has not lost any Hit Points. On a successful Save, it takes half as much Damage.3 Rounds
Advanced Medic Skills
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Anaesthesia3010OffensiveActionYou release a 15-foot-radius sphere of debillitating gas centered on a grounded point you can see within 20 feet of you. When a Creature enters the gas or starts its Turn there, they must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw or suffer Nervous Impairment until the beginning of their next Turn. The cloud moves 10 feet along the ground at the beginning of each of your Turns, as if it were moving away from the location you used this Skill at.3 Rounds
Auto-Protect2010AutomaticBonus ActionWhen you restore Hit Points to a Creature, you can activate this Skill to grant one of those Creatures Resistance to all Damage. That Creature loses that Resistance after they have taken any Damage, or after 1 minute has passed.Instant
Dangerous Operation3010AutomaticBonus ActionWhen you restore Hit Points to a single Creature, all hostile Creatures within 5 feet of that Creature must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failed Save, they take Necrotic Damage equal to half the Hit Points restored to the triggering Creature. On a successful Save, they take half as much Damage.3 Rounds
Doctor's Office3010AutomaticBonus ActionYour Speed becomes 0 for the duration and cannot be increased. However, when you roll to determine the Hit Points you restore to a Creature, you may roll one additional die and add it to the total, and if the result is less than half of the maximum, it becomes half of the maximum. You can end this Operator Skill early as a Bonus Action.3 Rounds
Healing Wave3520AutomaticActionYou release a surge of restorative Arts that lands with a physical force; you project a 15-foot square originating from you. All hostile Creatures within the area must make a Strength Saving Throw, taking 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage and being pushed to the edge of the area on a failed Save. On a successful Save, they take half as much Damage, and are not pushed. One allied Creature of your choice within the area recovers 2d6 Hit Points.Instant
Laser Focus2020AutomaticActionAs part of using this Skill, you may cast an Art with a Casting Time of Action, and that covers an Area of Effect (such as a Cone, Sphere, or Cube). The range and affected area of that Art is replaced with a Line originating from you, 120 feet in length and 5 foot in width, for that casting only. Creatures that have to make a Saving Throw against that Art this Turn have Disadvantage on that Saving Throw.Instant
Nature's Blessing3015AutomaticActionGrowth-promoting energy surges for a moment in a 10-foot-radius sphere centred on a point you can see within 60 feet. Each creature of your choice in the Sphere must make a Constitution saving throw against your Spell Save DC, taking 3d6 Necrotic damage on a failed Save or half as much damage on a successful Save. Additionally, one Creature of your choice in that area regains 3d6 Hit Points.Instant
Self-Defence Shock2020DefensiveActionChoose a Creature you can see within 10 feet; target Creature must make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Martial DC. On a failed Save, they are Stunned until the end of their next Turn. On a successful Save, their Movement Speed is halved until the end of their next Turn.Instant
Slow Release Medication4020AutomaticActionAllied Creatures you can see within 20 feet take half Damage. However, at the end of your next Turn, they lose Hit Points equal to the Damage they took.3 Rounds
To Take Umbrage3515AutomaticActionChoose a willing Creature you can see within 30 feet; once per Turn, when a Creature hits that Creature with an Attack, the Attacker takes 1d12 Force Damage, and the Attacked Creature restores Hit Points equal to half of the Damage dealt.5 Rounds
Protocol: Medical3515AutomaticBonus ActionYou create an Air Support Automaton (Page 466) at a location you can see within 10 feet. You control this Automaton as if you were an Artificer (See the Artificer Supporter's Master of Machines Feature); this Automaton does not count against the maximum number of Automatons you can control. The Automaton you create in this way can only take the following Action, as an Action; choose a Creature within 10 feet of the Automaton. That Creature regains 2d6 Hit Points. At the end of the duration, the Automaton self-destructs.10 Rounds
Elite Medic Skills
NameSP CostStart SPChargingActivationEffectDuration
Echoes of Life6540AutomaticActionChoose a Creature you can see within 100 feet; you restore 2d8 Hit Points to that Creature, five times.Instant
Empathic Obliteration6020AutomaticReactionWhen a Creature within 60 feet that you can see would take Damage, you can use this Operator Skill. The triggering Creature takes no Damage, but may still suffer additional effects. Then, choose a different Creature you can see within 60 feet; that Creature takes that instance of Damage instead (but does not suffer additional effects).Instant
In Tune5030AutomaticActionOriginium Arts permeate your very form, temporarily ascending you to a higher state. For the duration, Attacks made against you are made at Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on all Saving Throws. Furthermore, whenever you roll a d20, if the natural result of the dice is 9 or less, treat it as if you had rolled a 10.5 Rounds
Leyline6530AutomaticActionFor the duration, your Movement Speed is reduced to 0 and cannot be increased. However, you gain a +3 Bonus to your Spell Attack Rolls, your Spell Save DC is increased by 3, and when you roll to determine the Damage or Hit Points restored of an Art, if the result is less than half of the maximum, it becomes equal to half of the maximum. You may end this Skill early as an Action during your Turn.5 Rounds
Light of Hope6530AutomaticActionYou summon a Light of Hope in a location you can see. The Light is intangible, cannot be damaged or moved, and projects bright light in a 30-foot radius around it. For the duration of the Skill, Friendly Creatures within 15-foot of the Light have Advantage on Wisdom and Charisma Saving Throws, and gain Temporary Hit Points at the beginning of each of their Turns equal to your Character Level. Once per Turn, when you hit a Creature with an Attack while you are within 15-feet of a Light of Hope, that Creature loses 1d8 Hit Points.5 Rounds
Miracle10030AutomaticActionYou reach out and touch a Creature within 5 feet of you; that Creature is restored to its maximum Hit Points.Instant
Supreme Acuity8020AutomaticNo Action RequiredFor the duration of this Operator Skill, you may Concentrate on two Arts at the same time. If you fail a Constitution Saving Throw to maintain Concentration, you drop Concentration on one Art; you choose which one.Until Long Rest
Supreme Care10030AutomaticBonus ActionFor the duration, whenever you roll to determine the amount of Hit Points you restore to a Creature, you may roll one additional die and add it to the total. Additionally, once per Turn when you roll to determine the amount of Hit Points restored, you may roll those dice a second time and use either total.Until Long Rest
The Past, Unwritten8040AutomaticActionChoose two willing Creatures you can see within 100 feet; add up their total Hit Points, and divide the result by two, rounding up. If the current Hit Points of either Creature are less than this value, they gain Hit Points until it is equal to that value; this is considered to be you restoring Hit Points to that Creature.Instant
Touch the Heavens5030AutomaticBonus ActionThe next Art you cast this Turn that has a Range of 10 feet or more has its Range multiplied by 10. If the Spell affects a Line or Cone Area of Effect, the length of those areas is doubled.1 Round
Basic Medic Talents
NameEffectModule Effect
AlacrityYour Speed increases by 10 feet.When you take the Dash Action, you add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armour Class until the end of the Turn.
AlertYou gain a Bonus to your Initiative Rolls equal to your Proficiency Bonus.You have Advantage on Initiative Rolls.
Armoured CasterYou gain Proficiency with Light Armour.While you are wearing Light Armour, you have a +1 Modifier to Dexterity Saving Throws.
Booster ShotWhen you roll Initiative, choose one Creature within 30 feet you can see; that Creature recovers Hit Points equal to 1d4 + your Spellcasting Ability Modifier .You may choose two Creatures instead of one.
EnforcerCreatures with less than 50% of their maximum Hit Points remaining have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your Arts.If one of your Arts or Operator Skills reduces a Creature to Hit Points equal to or less than your Character Level, they die.
Growing StrongWhen you restore 5 or more Hit Points in a single instance to a Creature with 50 or more maximum Hit Points, the amount of Hit Points you restore is increased by your Spellcasting Ability Modifier.When you restore 5 or more Hit Points in a single instance to a Creature with 100 or more maximum Hit Points, the amount of Hit Points you restore is additionally increased by your Proficiency Bonus. If you are already adding your Proficiency Bonus, your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for that instance instead.
Hunter (X)Choose one from: Aberration, Beast, Celestials, Construct, Fiends, Monstrosity, Plants, Undead. Your Attacks against Creatures with that Creature Type deal additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.You gain a Bonus to Attack Rolls against Creatures with that Creature Type equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
LuckyYou have two Luck Points. You can spend 1 Luck Point to either grant yourself Advantage on a d20 roll, or grant an enemy Disadvantage on an Attack Roll against you. You regain all expended Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.Your maximum Luck Points becomes equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Reserved MedicIf you did not restore Hit Points to a Creature during your last Turn, the first time during your Turn that you roll to determine the amount of Hit Points you restore to a Creature, you may roll 1 additional die and add it to the total amount.If the Creature you restored Hit Points to on your last Turn was yourself, you are not considered to have restored Hit Points for the purposes of this Feature.
Timely InterventionWhenever you roll to determine the Hit Points you restore to a Creature while it is not your Turn, you may add your Spellcasting Ability Modifier to the amount rolled.This Feature now applies to any Hit Points you restore when it is not your Turn, instead of only applying to rolls.
ToughYour Hit Point Maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your Character Level. When you gain a Character Level thereafter, your Hit Point Maximum increases by an additional two points.Whenever you expend a Hit Dice to restore your Hit Points, you recover additional Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Traditional RemediesOver the course of a Long Rest, you can choose a number of Creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus who are also taking a Long Rest. If those Creatures complete that Long Rest, their maximum Hit Points are increased by 2d6, and they regain Hit Points to meet their new maximum Hit Points. This increase in Maximum Hit Points remains until those Creatures next complete a Long Rest. A Creature can only have its Maximum Hit Points increased in this way once per Long Rest.The increase in maximum Hit Points becomes 4d6.
Advanced Medic Talents
NameEffectModule Effect
Arts WardWhen a Creature you can see within 30 feet of you would take Arts Damage, you can use this Feature as a Reaction. You can expend a number of Arts Points up to a value equal to your Proficiency Bonus; roll a d6 for each Arts Points expended in this way. The Arts Damage taken by that Creature is reduced by the total value rolled.You roll 2d6 for each Art Point expended instead.
Black Queen's ProtectionWhen you restore 10 or more Hit Points to a Creature in a single Turn, that Creature gains Damage Reduction against Physical Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This Damage Reduction is lost after they take Physical Damage, or at the end of their next Turn.The Damage Reduction is no longer lost after they take Physical Damage.
Elemental SpecialistChoose an Arts Damage Type. You become Resistant to that Damage Type, and when you roll to determine Damage dealt by that Damage Type, you may reroll any result of 1, but must use the new result.Whenever you cast an Art that deals that Damage Type, you roll one additional dice of that Damage Type.
Energy RedirectionChoose an Arts Damage Type; you gain Resistance to that Damage Type. When you finish a Long Rest, you may change the Damage Type you have chosen. Additionally, as a Reaction when you take Damage that you are Resistant or Immune to, choose a Creature you can see within 60 feet to direct Damage of the same Type towards them. That Creature must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC, taking 4d8 Damage on a failed Save, or half as much on a successful one.You may choose two Damage Types for this Feature, as opposed to just one.
Escape ArtistYou can take the Disengage Action as a Bonus Action during your Turn.Whenever you take the Disengage Action, it ends the Grappled Condition on you.
Extra AttackYou can Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack Action.You have a +1 to Attack and Damage Rolls for non-Spell Attacks.
Hammer and AnvilOnce per Turn, when you hit a Creature within 5 feet of an allied Creature with a Ranged Attack, that Attack deals additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.The range at which this Feature is effective is increased to 10 feet.
Hidden TechniqueYou gain 2 Grit Points, and learn 3 Basic Brawler Techniques of your choice from the Brawler Branch of the Guard Class. You recover all expended Grit whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest.You gain 1 additional Grit Point, and learn 2 more Techniques.
Intensive CareAs a Long Rest Activity, you can provide deep care for a Creature that has any failed Death Saving Throws. When they complete that Long Rest, they remove all failed Death Saving Throws.In addition, that Creature can gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Character Level.
JumpstartThe Start SP of your Operator Skills is increased by 5.The Start SP of your Operator Skills is increased by 10 instead.
Knowledge is PowerAfter you roll a Saving Throw, you may add a bonus equal to your Spellcasting Ability Modifier to the result of that Saving Throw; you may do this after you have seen the result of the roll, but before the DM tells you if the roll has passed or failed. You may use this Feature twice, and regain all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.You now regain use of this Feature after completing a Short or Long Rest.
LieutenantYou learn two Instructions of your Choice from the Instructor Branch of the Guard Class. Furthermore, you gain 2 Instruction Dice, which are d6s. While you have Instruction Dice remaining, you may take the Help Action to aid an ally in attacking a Creature as a Bonus Action, and the target of that Attack can be within 30ft of you, rather than within 5ft. However, if you do so, you must use an Instruction as part of that Help Action. You regain all expended Instruction Dice upon completing a Long Rest.You gain a third Instruction Dice, and your Instruction Dice become d8s.
Advanced Medic Talents Continued
NameEffectModule Effect
Mirror MoveWhen a Creature you can see within 30 feet deals Arts Damage to you, you can expend your Reaction to deal 2d8 Force Damage to that Creature. You can use this Feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and regain all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.The Force Damage is increased to 4d8.
Reflected ShineWhen you restore Hit Points to another Creature, you can recover Hit Points equal to half of the Hit Points restored to that Creature.If you would gain an excess of Hit Points from this Feature, you may gain that excess as Temporary Hit Points.
Reliable TalentWhen you make a Check using a Skill you are Proficient in, treat any result on the d20 of 8 or less as an 8.You cannot have Disadvantage on any Check using a Skill or Tool you are Proficient with.
Responsive HealingWhenever you roll to determine the amount of Hit Points you restore to a Creature, that Creature gains 3 SP.Restores 6 SP instead,
Tissue NecrosisWhen you deal Necrotic Damage, you can force one of the Creatures you Damaged (your choice) to make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failed Save, they are Poisoned until the end of their next Turn. On a successful Save, nothing happens. You can use this Feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and regain all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.When a Creature gains the Poisoned Condition as a result of this Feature, they also gain the Necrotised Condition for the same duration.
We ContinueWhenever you are required to make a Saving Throw at the beginning or end of your Turn to end the Dazed, Stunned, or Paralyzed Conditions, you can make that Saving Throw at the beginning and end of your Turn.If it is the second time in a Turn that you have attempted a particular Saving Throw, you have Advantage on that Saving Throw.
White Queen's ProtectionWhen you restore 10 or more Hit Points to a Creature in a single Turn, that Creature gains Resistance against Arts Damage. This Resistance is lost after they take Arts Damage, or at the end of their next Turn.The Damage Reduction is no longer lost after they take Arts Damage.

migrated.name: Inventor: Wingsuit
migrated.content:
Wingsuit

Item: Light Armour or Clothing

This armour is fitted with lightweight webbing that allows for temporary gliding. When the wearer of this armour would fall or is falling a distance great enough for them to take falling Damage, they can activate this Modification as a Reaction; they gain a Flying Speed of 30 feet until they touch the floor, but they cannot ascend using this Flying Speed, and must descend at least 10 feet each Turn.

Such is your aptitude and skill that what you say goes.

When a Creature rolls one of your Aid Die, you may add your Proficiency Bonus to the result of that roll.

Effect: When this Automaton deals Weapon Damage to a Creature, that Creature does not gain the benefit of cover until the start of your next Turn. Additionally, the Automaton gains a bright spotlight, capable of shining a 30 foot cone of bright light, with a further 30 feet of dim light.

migrated.name: Artificer: Rotary Crossbow (Requires Crossbow)
migrated.content:
Rotary Crossbow (Requires Crossbow)

Effect: Once per Turn, when this Automaton makes an Attack using a Crossbow, it may make an additional Attack with that Crossbow as part of that Action.
migrated.rawSource:
##### Rotary Crossbow (Requires Crossbow)
**Effect:** Once per Turn, when this Automaton makes an Attack using a Crossbow, it may make an additional Attack with that Crossbow as part of that Action.

migrated.name: Artificer: Search and Rescue Suite (Platform Only)
migrated.content:
Search and Rescue Suite (Platform Only)

Effect: This Automaton possesses powerful "arms" that it uses to relocate people, willingly or otherwise.

The Automaton is treated as being two sizes larger for the purposes of lifting and carrying. Additionally, as an Action, it may target a Creature within 5 feet of itself and attempt to move them. If the Creature is unwilling, it must succeed on a Strength Saving Throw against your Artificer DC. On a failed Save, or if the Creature is willing, this Automaton may immediately move up to half its Speed, moving the Creature with it.

migrated.name: Artificer: Smoke Launcher
migrated.content:
Smoke Launcher

Effect: The Automaton can produce obscuring smoke as an Action; the smoke cloud is a 20 foot radius Sphere centred on the Automaton, and lasts until the end of your next Turn. For the Duration, any Attack that would pass into or out of the smoke is made at Disadvantage.

This Automaton may perform this Action a number of times equal to your Intelligence Modifier, and regains all expended uses when it and its Creator complete a Short Rest at the same time.

migrated.content:
Tracer Shots (Requires Crossbow)

Effect: After this Automaton has dealt Damage to a Creature using its Crossbow, the next Ranged Attack made against that Creature before the beginning of your next Turn is made at Advantage.

migrated.name: Artificer: Mounted Crossbow
migrated.content:
Mounted Crossbow

Effect: This Mobile Cover has a Heavy Crossbow mounted upon it. A Creature within 5 feet of the Mobile Cover can use this Crossbow as if they had it equipped; a Creature is considered Proficient with this Crossbow as long as they have an Intelligence Score of 8 or higher.
migrated.rawSource:
##### Mounted Crossbow
**Effect:** This Mobile Cover has a Heavy Crossbow mounted upon it. A Creature within 5 feet of the Mobile Cover can use this Crossbow as if they had it equipped; a Creature is considered Proficient with this Crossbow as long as they have an Intelligence Score of 8 or higher.

migrated.name: Artificer: Reinforced
migrated.content:
Reinforced

Effect: This Mobile Cover is considered to be Three-Quarters Cover against Ranged Attacks, and Half Cover against Melee Attacks.
migrated.rawSource:
##### Reinforced
**Effect:** This Mobile Cover is considered to be Three-Quarters Cover against Ranged Attacks, and Half Cover against Melee Attacks.

migrated.name: Artificer: Stimulant Vaporiser
migrated.content:
Stimulant Vaporiser

Effect: This Mobile Cover is fitted with a vaporiser that is filled with a heady mix of anaesthetic gases and combat stimulants. Creatures that begin their Turn within 5 feet of the Mobile Cover can gain Temporary Hit Points equal to one roll of your Aid Dice.

After one minute, the vaporiser is exhausted, and no longer has any effect.

migrated.name: Artificer: Ultralight
migrated.content:
Ultralight

Effect: An allied Creature within 5 feet of the Mobile Cover can use a Bonus Action to begin shoving the Mobile Cover. Until the end of their Turn, when they perform grounded movement, they also move the Mobile Cover as they go.

migrated.name: 20th Level: Approaching Storm
migrated.content:
20th Level: Approaching Storm

Like a force of nature, you roll over the unready.

When you roll to determine Damage dealt during the first Round of a combat, you may add half of your Vanguard Level to the result rolled.
