Basic Vanguard Talents
NameEffectModule Effect
AlacrityYour Speed increases by 10 feet.When you take the Dash Action, you add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armour Class until the end of the Turn.
AlertYou gain a Bonus to your Initiative Rolls equal to your Proficiency Bonus.You have Advantage on Initiative Rolls.
Clean SweepOnce per Round, when you roll to determine the Damage you deal to a Creature with more than half of its maximum Hit Points, you deal 1 additional die of Damage to that Creature.This Feature is no longer limited to once per Round.
CounterstrikeAttacks you make when it is not your Turn deal additional Damage equal to the Ability Modifier you used for that Attack.Attacks you make when it is not your Turn are made at Advantage.
Critical EdgeYour Critical Range is increased by 1.You can roll one additional Damage die when determining the extra Damage for a Critical Hit.
Hunter (X)Choose one from: Aberration, Beast, Celestials, Construct, Fiends, Monstrosity, Plants, Undead. Your Attacks against Creatures with that Creature Type deal additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.You gain a Bonus to Attack Rolls against Creatures with that Creature Type equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
LuckyYou have two Luck Points. You can spend 1 Luck Point to either grant yourself Advantage on a d20 roll, or grant an enemy Disadvantage on an Attack Roll against you. You regain all expended Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.Your maximum Luck Points becomes equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Martial AcumenYou gain a Fighting Style from one of the Styles available to the Guard Class.As a Bonus Action, you may grant a Weapon you have Equipped the Couch, Deadly, or Crush (3) Property until the beginning of your next Turn.
Matter of PrincipleWhen you would reduce a Creature to 0 Hit Points, you can instead choose to reduce them to 1 Hit Point; for the next minute, that Creature cannot recover Hit Points, is Dazed, and if they are reduced to 0 Hit Points by a Creature other than you, that Creature gains 3 SP.When a Creature gains SP as a result of this Feature, you also gain that SP.
ParryWhen you are hit by an Attack while you have a Melee Weapon or Shield equipped, you may use your Reaction to increase your AC by 1d4 for the duration of that Attack, possibly causing that Attack to miss. If you also have the Defensive Fighting Style, your AC is increased by 2d4 instead.The d4 is improved one step to d6.
PatrolmanWhen there are two or more hostile Creatures within your Reach, you gain Damage Resistance against Physical Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.This Damage Resistance is now against All Damage.
Savage AttackerOnce per Turn, when you deal Damage as a result of an Attack, you can roll the Damage for that Attack twice and choose which of the results you want.When you use this Feature, that Attack deals additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Scout's LeadWhen an allied Creature within 30 feet that can see or hear you would take Damage from an environmental source (such as fire, falling, or a trap), you can use your Reaction to roll 1d8 and reduce the Damage they take from that source by the amount rolled multiplied by your Proficiency Bonus.When an allied Creature within 30 feet that can see or hear you would take Damage from an environmental source, you can use your Reaction to make that Creature take half Damage from that instance of Damage.
The Wheel TurnsWhen a Creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points within your Reach, you gain 1 Skill Point.You gain 3 Skill Points instead.
TirelessAs a Bonus Action, you may grant yourself Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d8 + your Constitution Modifier. You may use this Feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and regain all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.The amount of Temporary Hit Points you gain is instead equal to 2d8 + your Constitution Modifier.
ToughYour Hit Point Maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your Character Level. When you gain a Character Level thereafter, your Hit Point Maximum increases by an additional two points.Whenever you expend a Hit Dice to restore your Hit Points, you recover additional Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Unarmoured AgilityWhile you are wearing no Armour, your Speed increases by 20ft.While you are wearing no Armour, you have a Bonus to your Dexterity Saving Throws equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Advanced Vanguard Talents
NameEffectModule Effect
Alpha StrikeThe first time you deal Damage to a Creature with an Attack, that Attack deals 1d12 additional Weapon Damage. It is considered to be the first time you hit a Creature if you have rolled Initiative since the last time you hit them with an Attack.The additional Damage becomes 2d12.
AmbushAfter you roll Initiative, you deal 1 additional dice of Damage with your Attacks until the end of your next Turn.This additional Damage now applies to all Damage you deal, not just Attacks.
Clear Heart, Clear HeadWhen your Hit Points are reduced to lower than half of their maximum, you may activate this Feature as a Reaction. For 1 minute, your AC is increased by a value equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you recover 1d8 missing Hit Points at the beginning of your Turn. This Hit Point restoration cannot restore you to more than half of your maximum Hit Points. Once you have used this Feature, you may not do so again until you have completed a Long Rest.The Hit Point recovery is increased to 2d8.
Collateral DamageOnce per Turn when you score a Critical Hit, you can choose a different Creature within 10 feet of the original Creature; that Creature takes Damage equal to the additional Damage of the Critical Hit.No longer limited to once per Turn.
Danger SenseWhile you are conscious, you have Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against effects you can see.Invisible Creatures no longer have Advantage on Attack Rolls against you, and you can no longer be Suprised while Conscious.
ElusiveIf a Creature you can see makes an Attack Roll against you with Advantage, you can use your Reaction to remove the Advantage from that Attack Roll. You may use this Feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and regain all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.Creatures that you can see can never have Advantage on Attacks against you unless you are Incapacitated.
First In, Last OutWhen a Creature misses you with a Melee Attack, until the end of your next Turn, your Attacks against that Creature are made at Advantage.When a Creature misses you with a Melee Attack, until the end of your next Turn, when you take the Attack Action, you may make one additional Attack as part of that Action; this effect is not cumulative.
Hidden TechniqueYou gain 2 Grit Points, and learn 3 Basic Brawler Techniques of your choice from the Brawler Branch of the Guard Class. You recover all expended Grit whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest.You gain 1 additional Grit Point, and learn 2 more Techniques.
Hunting HoundOnce per Short Rest, when you hit a Creature with an Attack, you can mark them as your Hunt Target. For 1 minute, whenever you hit that Creature with an Attack, they take 1d6 additional Force Damage.While they are marked as your Hunt Target, that Creature cannot benefit from the Invisible Condition, and you always know where they are.
JumpstartThe Start SP of your Operator Skills is increased by 5.The Start SP of your Operator Skills is increased by 10 instead.
Night WatchmanAs an Action, you can place a Shadow Sentry for 1 hour at a point within 10 feet of you. A Shadow Sentry is an invisible, intangible Arts Construct that cannot move or take any Actions. When a Creature moves within 10 feet of the Sentry, you are alerted to that movement, even if the Creature is Invisible or you are asleep. Once you have used this Feature, you may not do so again until you have completed a Long Rest.When you have been alerted to a Creature by your Shadow Sentry, you know the location of that Creature for the next minute.
One MomentWhile your Skill is Active, when you deal Damage to a Creature during your Turn, that Creature takes 1d10 Force Damage.The Force Damage taken is increased to 2d8.
OpportunistAttacks you make against Creatures with reduced Speed deal additional Damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.You may also deal this additional Damage against Creatures that have any detrimental Status Condition.
Part-Time InventorYou gain the Equipment Modification Feature of the Inventor Specialist. However, your maximum number of Inventions is 1, and you cannot apply any Modification marked as Dangerous.Your maximum number of Inventions becomes 2.
QuickburnWhile your current Hit Points and Maximum Hit Points are the same, you may add your Proficiency Bonus to all Attack Rolls you make. If you are already adding your Proficiency Modifier, double your Proficiency Bonus for those Attacks instead..While your current Hit Points and Maximum Hit Points are the same, you have +5 Bonus to Initiative Rolls, and your Speed is increased by 10ft.
Advanced Vanguard Talents Continued
NameEffectModule Effect
Reliable TalentWhen you make a Check using a Skill you are Proficient in, treat any result on the d20 of 8 or less as an 8.You cannot have Disadvantage on any Check using a Skill or Tool you are Proficient with.
Self DefenceWhile you have an Active Operator Skill, you gain Temporary Hit Points at the beginning of your Turn equal to your Proficiency Bonus.The amount of Temporary Hit Points you gain from this Feature is doubled.
Tactical MindWhen you roll a d20, you may reroll that die and add 1d10 to the result of the roll as a Reaction Once you have used this Feature, you must finish a Long Rest before you can use it again.You now regain use of this Feature when you complete a Short Rest.
WarbreedWhen an enemy within 15 feet of you is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may expend 1 Hit Die to roll that die and recover Hit Points equal to the amount rolled + your Constitution Modifier.Once per Short Rest, you may use this Feature without expending a Hit Dice.
WavebreakerIf there are three or more hostile Creatures within 15 feet of you, you have Advantage on Melee Attack Rolls.If there are three or more hostile Creatures within 15 feet of you, those Creatures have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you.

migrated.name: Tactician: Charge (3 Acumen)
migrated.content:
Charge (3 Acumen)

Choose a point you can see; allied Creatures within 10 feet of the chosen point can immediately use their Reaction to move up to their Speed; they must finish this movement as close to a hostile Creature as possible. If they finish this movement with at least one hostile Creature within their Reach, as part of the same Reaction they can make a Melee Weapon Attack against one of those hostile Creatures.
migrated.rawSource:

migrated.name: Tactician: Fall Back (1 Acumen)
migrated.content:
Fall Back (1 Acumen)

You command an ally to carefully fall back, avoiding undue harm. Choose an allied Creature; that Creature can immediately expend their Reaction to move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and then do so again. Each movement must move them away from hostile Creatures; they can only move closer if it is the only way to move closer to safety (E.G. they are surrounded).

You command an ally to move on the double. Choose an allied Creature; that Creature can immediately expend their Reaction to take the Dash Action.

migrated.content:
Pincer Manoeuvre (2 Acumen)

migrated.name: Tactician: Switch Ranks (2 Acumen)
migrated.content:
Switch Ranks (2 Acumen)

You command your allies to regroup, switching tired fighters for fresh ones. Choose a number of allied Creatures within 60 feet of you, up to your Intelligence Modifier or Wisdom Modifier. Each of those Creatures can swap places with a willing Creature that has a Speed of more than 0 within 10 feet of themselves, without either Creature provoking Opportunity Attacks. A Creature cannot swap into a space it does not fit in.

You command your allies to form up on your position. Choose a number of allied Creatures within 60 feet of you, up to your Intelligence Modifier or Wisdom Modifier; those Creatures can immediately move up to their Speed as a Reaction, but must finish that Movement within 15 feet of you if able, or as close to you as possible if they cannot.

migrated.name: Tactician: Bring Them Down (3 Acumen)
migrated.content:
Bring Them Down (3 Acumen)

You command for your allies to bring a Creature to their knees.
1) Choose a hostile Creature that is Large or smaller you can see to be the target, and a number of allied Creatures within 30 feet of it up to your Intelligence Modifier or Wisdom Modifier.
2) Each of these allied Creature may, as a Reaction, move up to their Speed; they must finish this movement as close to the target Creature as possible.
3) After the movement, if any of the allied Creatures are within 5 feet of the target Creature, the target Creature must succeed on a DC12 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked Prone; this DC is increased by 3 for each additional allied Creature that finished the movement within 5 feet of the target Creature.
4) If the target Creature is knocked Prone, they cannot stand up during their next Turn.

migrated.name: Tactician: Finish Them (3 Acumen)
migrated.content:
Finish Them (3 Acumen)

You command for an allied Creature to bring a swift and violent end to a foe. Choose an allied Creature that is within 5 feet of a hostile Creature that is either Prone, or has no Speeds above 0. The allied Creature can make a Weapon Attack against the hostile Creature; Ranged Attacks are not made at Disadvantage for the Creature being Prone, or for making an Ranged Attack while there is a Creature within 5 feet. If it hits, do not roll Damage for that Attack; instead, it deals the maximum possible Damage, and ignores any Damage Reduction on the target.

migrated.name: Tactician: Focus Fire (4 Acumen)
migrated.content:
Focus Fire (4 Acumen)

You command your allies to loose a devastating volley at a single foe. Choose a point you can see, and a hostile Creature you can see; allied Creatures within 10 feet of the chosen point can immediately use their Reaction to make a Ranged Weapon Attack against the chosen Creature, if able. These Attacks do not deal Damage individually; instead, combine the Damage of all of these Attacks into one instance of Damage.

migrated.name: Tactician: Shield Wall (2 Acumen)
migrated.content:
Shield Wall (2 Acumen)

You command your shielded allies to prepare for an assault, raising their shield. Choose a point you can see; allied Creatures that are wielding a Shield, or have the Defensive Fighting Fighting Style, within 10 feet of the chosen point can immediately use their Reaction to raise their defences. For each Creature that does so, all other Creatures within the area gain a +1 Bonus to AC until the start of your next Turn, or a +2 Bonus if the Shield is a Heavy Shield. Creatures only retain this Bonus so long as they remain within the area.
